The '''B1 grapple droid''' was a variation of the standard [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Instead of using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], their hands ended in claws which could block [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. They were distinguished from their B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] cousins by the [[Color/Legends|slate-gray]] coloring covering their entire bodies. They were also taller than the standard battle droid model. Their claws can lift up to 10 times their own weight. The design was produced because the Trade Federation wanted a dedicated close-range combat droid.<ref name="JPB guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Jedi Power Battles: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Jedi Power Battles'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

These droids were replaced by the [[B2 grapple droid/Legends|B2 Grapple Droid]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a variant of the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]].
